card.name: Inside Himalaya and rare proper names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of the word Himalaya/Himalayan (Himal, ayan, aya, imal) and of some other split proper names like Harlow, Hurley, humic. Mostly in science or geography text.

modes.label: Himalaya word pieces
modes.description: Fires on the pieces in the middle or end of Himalaya or Himalayan when the word is split.
